builder.objective: V2-03 — Score, équilibres et fenêtre gratuite. Transformer les CompletedEntry en équilibres de temps compréhensibles avec soldes fait-par/fait-pour, compensations pair-à-pair, graphes nommés, pondération secondaire Premium et historique filtré. La fenêtre Free est limitée au mois civil courant.
builder.scope: Score screen with: period selectors (Semaine/Mois/Année/Depuis le début), filters (Toutes/each PersistentTask/Autres), balance algorithm (+D performedBy, -D/N beneficiaries, sum=0), peer-to-peer compensation, real time performed per member, named bar charts, weighted secondary section (Premium), contextual filtered history. Free: current civil month only, upsell for Année/Depuis le début/archive. Monthly reset without data destruction. Upgrade restores archive immediately.
acceptance: Period selectors Semaine/Mois/Année/Depuis le début functional
Balance algorithm correct: +D to performedBy, -D/N to each beneficiary, sum of all balances = 0
Real time performed per member displayed
Named bar charts with names + values directly readable
Weighted secondary section displayed only when Premium entitlement active
Contextual filtered history shown under Score matching period + filter
Free tier: Score limited to current civil month (Semaine/Mois work, Année/Depuis le début show upsell)
Monthly reset: old data hidden in Free but persisted, upgrade restores immediately
Reference scenario values verified (two-member-core, three-member-beneficiaries, free-month-rollover)
Visual audit against DESIGN_BRIEF.md: neutral balance presentation, no winning/losing ranking, simple bar charts
All existing 195 tests pass with no regressions
